preconditions.description: The number of main courses k must be at least 1 and at most n, and n must be at least 1 and at most 100000.

preconditions.expression: len(main_courses) == k and all(1 <= course <= n for course in main_courses)
preconditions.description: The list of main courses must contain exactly k distinct integers, each between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= t_i <= n - 1 for t_i in dependencies) and sum(len(deps) for deps in dependencies) <= 100000
preconditions.description: Each course's dependency count must be between 0 and n-1, and the total number of dependencies must not exceed 100000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not valid_order else True
postconditions.description: If there is no valid order to pass the courses, output -1.

postconditions.expression: len(output_courses) == m and all(1 <= course <= n for course in output_courses)
postconditions.description: The output must contain m distinct course numbers, each between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(course in output_courses for course in main_courses)
postconditions.description: All main courses must be included in the output order.
